Dialogue_Text: Hello again, adventurer. Our Ink Gallery welcomes you with its tales.
Is there anything else you'd like to know?
We should talk downstairs. Unless you popped in only to see how I'm doing.
I hope you are having a fine day.
Hello, <CHARNAME>! You've seen all my books already—but perhaps you're here for one of the souvenirs?
So, from what I understood, by paying the fee I will be able to test myself in battles described in these books. Is that correct?
You said you came here from Cormyr, yes? Was it to open the Ink Gallery?
What happens if I successfully learn from all these books?
Don't you have any problems with the Cowled Wizards? Aren't these books magic?
I would like to buy some souvenirs.
Yes. From what I understood, by paying the fee I will be able to test myself in battles described in these books. Is that correct?
